Reason: Good quality habitat. Perched culvert blocked by beaver dams.
Notes: West Fraser has indicated (fall 2023) that they will update the crossing to a clearspan bridge during the next instream work window.

Reason: Site is likley to be a low flow barrier
Notes: Old earthen berm dam ~50 m long x 5 m high on upstream side. There is a 4 m wide breach in dam on river left, with 3 old outflow pipes buried under a log jam on upstream side of dam with some water still flowing through, though most flow is subsurface. Structure likely a barrier to fish passage at low water; at higher flows, fish can likely pass through the breach in the dam.
